text:
elaine: Heads-up: Nimbus marketplace listing goes live 11/15. Want to run a partner SEV drill Tue 11/12 at 10:00 PT to validate shared-channel alerts, bridge opening, and pager handoffs. Can Nimbus + SI reps join?

samir: 10:00 works for me but I have to drop at 10:35. Recommend 10:00-10:40 boxed window. Keep scenarios minimal.

jordan: @partners-rep-nimbus please confirm oncall lead for the drill. Also please have SI engineer and marketplace ops PM available (names below).

partners-rep-nimbus: Priya (Nimbus oncall) will attend. Marco (SI infra) can join for the first 30m.

lucy: I'll run the war-room play. Short checklist I plan to execute:
- create shared channel (#partners-nimbus-drill) and private war room (#nimbus-warroom)
- invite Priya, Marco, Anya (marketplace PM), elaine, samir, jordan, mike
- verify deploy-bot pings rotation and posts bridge link
- run 1 x sev2 partner report and follow standard escalation path

mike: I can script the channel + bot actions. Need to confirm routing mapping so deploy-bot knows which oncall rotation to page. Proposed config entry:
```
partners/nimbus: rotation=redwood-oncall-nimbus; open_bridge=true; ack_window_sec=300
```

deploy-bot: Note: staging run created channels: `#partners-nimbus-drill`, `#nimbus-warroom`. Bridge placeholder: https://zoom.example/warroom-1898765432

elaine: Thanks. lucy/mike can you own channel + bot setup? samir/jordan own the escalation doc & timing rules? I'll send calendar and invite Priya/Marco.

samir: On the ack timing: recommendation is partner -> immediate bot watch -> if message includes `sev:` tag then ping oncall immediately. If no ack in 5m, bot opens bridge and pages eng escalation list.

lucy: Agreed. Quick flow:
1) partner posts in #partners-nimbus-drill with `sev:1|sev:2`
2) deploy-bot relays to #nimbus-warroom and alerts `rotation=redwood-oncall-nimbus`
3) if unacked after 5m, bridge opens and `eng-sev` is paged
4) if marketplace availability/billing impacted, notify marketplace-ops pager + account lead

jordan: I'll draft a short post-drill note capturing times-to-ack and actions. Will share a doc before EOD.

partners-rep-nimbus: Confirmed attendee list: Priya, Marco (partial), Anya. 10:00 start is fine. Need the war-room link in advance.

elaine: Action items summary:
- lucy/mike: create channels + bot config (owner)
- samir/jordan: escalation doc + routing rules (owner)
- elaine: calendar invite and attendee confirmation (owner)
- partners-rep-nimbus: final attendee check (owner)
React with :white_check_mark: when you own yours.

mike: Bot config pushed to staging; scheduled channel creation at Tue 09:50 PT. Will auto-insert bridge link.

jordan: Draft doc: https://docs.internal/partners/nimbus-sev-drill (request access if needed).

elaine: Great work. We'll run the drill, record it, and follow up with a short retrospective. See you Tue 10:00 PT. :thumbsup:
